package.name: linkedgeodata
package.author: Universität Leipzig
package.notes: LinkedGeoData is an effort to add a spatial dimension to the Web of Data / Semantic Web. LinkedGeoData uses the information collected by the OpenStreetMap project and makes it available as an RDF knowledge base according to the Linked Data principles. It interlinks this data with other knowledge bases in the Linking Open Data initiative.
package.title: LinkedGeoData

package.maintainer: Très grand équipement Adonis and CCSD (CNRS)
package.name: isidore
package.author: Stéphane Pouyllau
package.notes: ISIDORE is a research platform, the object of which is to federate digital data from HSS research, thus providing a single access point for teachers, researchers, doctoral and junior students and also for third party web portals, using state-of-the-art data linking techniques.
package.title: Isidore

package.name: contaminanthydroontology
package.author: Semir S.
package.notes: CHO (Contaminant Hydrogeology Ontology) is a conceptual knowledge model for the contaminant hydrogeology domain in which concepts (classes, e.g. Contaminant, Aquifer), their relationships (properties, e.g. contaminates), and constraints are defined using the OWL constructs.  From a Contaminant.owl file, CHO is instantiated with various data (e.g., water quality data, hazardous sites locations...) for Georgia, USA.  CHO is integrated with DBpedia and SWEET ontologies.
package.title: ContaminantHydroOntology
